data: Japan's first private Moon landing attempts; Mission 1 (2023) and Mission 2 (2025) both crashed
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

Hakuto-R is a lunar lander program of the Japanese company ispace. Its Mission 1 lander, launched in December 2022, was Japan's first private attempt at a Moon landing and crashed in April 2023. The Mission 2 lander, Resilience, crashed in June 2025.
First landing near the lunar south pole
First U.S. lunar landing since Apollo; sideways
Pinpoint lunar landing; toppled but operational
First-ever lunar far-side sample return. Apollo basin landing 2024-06-01 (UTC); 1935 g returned to Inner Mongolia 2024-06-25
